title: Collision height correct
description: Essential Criteria: The student's answer for part (1) must be exactly 1 m (or equivalent).

title: Post-collision velocity correct
description: Essential Criteria: The student's answer for part (2) must be exactly 0 m/s.

title: Energy loss correct
description: Essential Criteria: The student's answer for part (3) must be exactly 12 J.

title: Kinematics for object A
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly applies the equation for displacement under constant acceleration to find object A's position or velocity at t=0.2s.

title: Kinematics for object B
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly uses the collision height to solve for object B's initial launch velocity or its velocity just before impact.

title: Momentum conservation applied
description: Important Criteria: The student sets up and solves the conservation of momentum equation for the perfectly inelastic collision, accounting for direction (signs).

title: Energy calculation method
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly calculates the mechanical energy loss as the difference between total kinetic energy before and after the collision.

title: Sign error in momentum
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student fails to assign opposite signs to the velocities of A (downward) and B (upward) in the momentum conservation equation.

title: Unit omission or error
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student provides numerical answers without the correct units (m, m/s, J) or uses incorrect units.
